description: Declares the ADDITIVE collaborative-write grants bug-reports needs. Read by install-collection Step 5.5 and provisioned via the permission-change-helper skill (admin reviews + Accepts). Never applied by aifs_share directly. {param} placeholders are resolved at provisioning time from collection-setup-responses.md and org-config.json. NOTE: this file declares grants only (op:share). Access RESTRICTIONS (e.g. hiding config/auth-key.txt from members) are NOT expressible as a share and are tracked/handled separately — see bug 20260601-8d20ea22.

acls.rationale: Every member files bugs into bugs/ via report-bug. Unique-by-construction filenames mean no write contention. Additive grant on top of the parent all@ reader; new bug files inherit it.
